$comment: Example tasks published on the Store by scripts/publish-tasks.mjs after every deploy (CI only). Each one is a search people type, with its own Google-indexed landing page and .md (manager/rules/SEO.md). Presets are companies with public programs.

tasks.name: does-company-have-bug-bounty-program
tasks.title: Does a company have a bug bounty program? Check in one run
tasks.description: Check whether a company runs a public bug bounty or vulnerability disclosure program, on HackerOne, on Bugcrowd and in its own security.txt, with the program link, scope hints and reporting contact. Type a company name or domain; replace shopify with your target.
tasks.seoTitle: Bug Bounty Program Lookup - HackerOne, Bugcrowd
tasks.seoDescription: Does a company run a bug bounty or disclosure program? Check HackerOne, Bugcrowd and its security.txt in one run, with program links and contacts.

tasks.name: security-txt-checker
tasks.title: security.txt checker: where to report a site's vulnerabilities
tasks.description: Read a domain's /.well-known/security.txt and get its security contact, disclosure policy, encryption key, acknowledgments page and expiry date, plus subsidiaries or brand domains you add. A quick way to find where to report a vulnerability.
tasks.seoDescription: Read a domain's security.txt: security contact, disclosure policy, PGP key, acknowledgments and expiry. Add brand domains to check them in one run.
